title: Robots in prefab

captions.instagram:
What do robots actually do in a factory-built home? Four jobs: cut, assemble, move, measure.

What automation adds is repetition: the same task, the same way, every time, in a setting that doesn't change with the weather. That's what robotics-driven means to me, and it's a pillar of BUILT®.

Save the 4 questions about factory-built homes.

Would you live in a factory-built home?
captions.linkedin:
On site, conditions change every day. In a factory, the process repeats.

Robots in prefab construction do four jobs: cut, assemble, move and measure. What automation adds is consistency: repetitive tasks done the same way, parts made to close tolerances, and less of the uncertainty that comes with site-based building.

BUILT® is robotics-driven, one of its four pillars.

Four questions I'd ask about any factory-built home: What is made in the factory? What happens on site? How is quality checked? How are parts transported?
